captions: Saturday, 7:20 a.m. A walk by the river to clear your head.
Earbuds in. War. Prices. A crash on the motorway.
Your heart is racing, and you haven’t even had coffee.
An old man rows past. Slowly. No phone. No hurry.
A leaf lands on the water. It doesn’t fight the current.
You take the earbuds out. For the first time — silence.
You climb the hill. Phone face down in your pocket.
SubhanAllah with each step. Alhamdulillah at the top.
The news hasn’t changed. Your heart has.

post.caption:
11 headlines before breakfast. Not one word for Allah. 🌿

Earbuds in. War. Prices. A crash on the motorway. Your heart is racing before your first coffee — while an old man rows past on the river, slowly, no phone, no hurry.

“Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.” (13:28)

This morning, before any headline: ten minutes with Allah.
